text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein discusses in London with British Prime Minister Major how to push forward the Middle East peace process.

- King says he will do his utmost to help Palestinians and that "progress in Syrian and Lebanese tracks must be part of efforts." Major says king's "commitment to peace is a model of a statesman we admire."

- Crown Prince Hassan stresses the importance of the Swiss initiative in encouraging trade in Middle East and North Africa; prince holds talks with Swiss leaders on developing bilateral ties and economic links.
- Hamas leader Abu Marzook welcomes any agreement to hand him over to Jordan; contacts continue between Amman and Tel Aviv and Washington to reach a final solution.
- A second batch of Algerian patients to arrive in Amman at end of February for treatment in Jordanian hospitals under a medical cooperation accord between the two countries.
- Prime Minister Kabariti flies to London to join king in next week's official visits to Ireland and Germany.
- Crown prince arrives in Berne from Paris and meets top Swiss officials to promote investment in Jordan.
